observable_axial_progress.review_scope: Full-duration sampled native-view review, all-frame decoding, detailed extraction samples, native final states, and complete per-step telemetry replay. Micrometre seating is established by contact/geometry telemetry, not image resolution.
observable_axial_progress.failure_validation_scope: Offline unit tests plus scorer counterfactuals and independent geometry reconstruction from recorded live traces; these are not additional physical fault-injection trials.
observable_axial_progress.scoring_clarification: The 0.5-second contact hold is an outcome condition, independent of socket presence. Extraction contact loss clears full credit; a fresh exposed-seat hold must requalify it. All physical contact thresholds are unchanged.
limitations: Two successful repetitions use the same seed and fixed layout; they do not establish robustness to randomized layouts.
The scripted reference uses simulator pose feedback.
No verified service torque or clamp preload is claimed.
Trace files retain per-control contact summaries, not every raw substep manifold.

historical_revisions.notes: The following records preserve prior trials and their original validation/publication fields. They are historical evidence only; current results belong to observable_axial_progress.

dream.observed_outcome: No successful ratchet pickup or socket placement; action limit reached.

clearance_criterion.initial_condition: Both arms READY/open; ratchet in physical cradle, separate from started bolt with 2.5 mm under-head gap.
clearance_criterion.fidelity: NVIDIA ratchet visuals plus original socket, bolt, grip pads, cradle and fixture. Physical contacts support pickup and transmit socket torque. A native one-way clutch and pitch joint drive rotation and axial travel. Thread ridges are visual; tooth impacts, deformation and fastener strength are omitted. Both arms start at rest and the tool is separate from the bolt. No hand/tool or socket/bolt attachments are used. Tightening is judged by seating and ratchet cycles.

limitations: Saved trace contains per-control summaries, not raw per-substep contact manifolds.
Small positive separations up to 2 um are allowed only with a measured seating impulse and geometry checks.
Images reviewed show rest, pickup, placement and hold; the socket occludes the seating interface.
The policy uses simulator pose feedback; the matching Dream run is recorded separately and no robot-only perception claim is made.
